display.title: Our Secret Weapon: Defeating the Yetzer Hara with Torah and Mitzvos
display.summary_short: Members of Tzivos Hashem are united in one battle: the more Torah we learn and mitzvos we do, the weaker the Yetzer Hara gets, until it surrenders before Moshiach comes.
display.summary_long: A short pep talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi tells children that being a member of Hashem's army means being united with thousands of Jewish children around the world in doing good together: learning as much Torah and doing as many mitzvos as possible, more than ever before. That is how we win the battle against our real enemy, the Yetzer Hara, the little voice that tempts us to do wrong. Every bit of Torah and every mitzvah weakens it, until it becomes so helpless that it surrenders and says, 'Members of Tzivos Hashem, you win, I give up!' Torah and mitzvos are our secret weapon. And since Moshiach is on his way, and we want him to come today, what better way to greet him than with a total victory over our own Yetzer Hara?
display.lesson: Torah and mitzvos are our secret weapon: each one weakens the Yetzer Hara, until we win the battle and are ready to greet Moshiach.

date.note: Cut from episode 135 (the Three Weeks 5744, by weekly spacing). The same talk was repeated in many later episodes.
